message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-08 05:10 IST to 2026-09-09 05:10 IST (2026-09-07 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-08 23:40 UTC)

This independent primary-product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases were normalized and duplicates merged. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

Fresh, credible disclosures were found for MongoDB Server, Cisco UCS, Microsoft Windows/Office/SQL Server, Adobe Photoshop/Acrobat, and the official ONLYOFFICE ownCloud connector. Microsoft and MongoDB published unusually large same-day sets, so related CVEs are grouped below without duplicating overlapping reports.

### 1. MongoDB Server authorization may remain disabled at startup

- **Issue:** CVE-2026-82067
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 4.0 9.2 (CVSS 3.1 8.1 High)
- **Description:** Case-insensitive configuration validation can leave authorization disabled at startup under the affected condition, allowing an unauthenticated network user to perform administrative operations.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB is explicitly monitored. Affected versions are 7.0.x before 7.0.41, 8.0.x before 8.0.30, and 8.3.x before 8.3.9.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-82067)

### 2. MongoDB unauthenticated denial-of-service paths

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-82064 and CVE-2026-82075
- **Severity:** High; CVE-2026-82064 is CVSS 3.1 7.5, and CVE-2026-82075 is CVSS 4.0 8.7 (CVSS 3.1 7.5).
- **Description:** One flaw can terminate a specific replica-set member through reachable read-concern processing; the other lets an unauthenticated client exhaust CPU in the `mongos` sharded-cluster router.
- **Relevance:** These directly affect MongoDB Server and `mongos`. CVE-2026-82075 affects 7.0.x before 7.0.41, 8.0.x before 8.0.30, and 8.3.x before 8.3.9; the source for CVE-2026-82064 does not identify the exact affected replica-set member configuration.
- **Sources:** [CVE-2026-82064](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-82064), [CVE-2026-82075](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-82075)

### 3. Additional MongoDB Server disclosure cohort

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-82052 through CVE-2026-82063, plus CVE-2026-82065, CVE-2026-82066, and CVE-2026-82068.
- **Severity:** Record-specific, ranging from Low to High. Notable High issues include CVE-2026-82054 (CVSS 4.0 7.1 resource-exhaustion DoS), CVE-2026-82055 (7.1 GeoJSON/2dsphere crash), CVE-2026-82058 (7.1 JSON Schema crash), and CVE-2026-82061 (CVSS 3.1 8.1 use-after-free with integrity and availability impact).
- **Description:** The cohort covers incorrect LDAP role assignment, change-stream data-integrity errors, authorization bypass of internal storage operations, memory disclosure, use-after-free conditions, persistent metadata-triggered crashes, and several authenticated denial-of-service paths.
- **Relevance:** All are MongoDB-assigned records for MongoDB Server. Most affect one or more of 7.0.x before 7.0.41, 8.0.x before 8.0.30, and 8.3.x before 8.3.9; some apply only to 8.3.x, so version matching should be performed per CVE.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [CVE Program search](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord/SearchResults?query=MongoDB%20CVE-2026-820)

**MongoDB ecosystem coverage:** The dedicated sweep also checked Community and Enterprise editions, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations. No additional fresh, credible finding outside the MongoDB Server cohort above was verified in the window.

### 4. Cisco UCS Secure Boot bypass

- **Issue:** CVE-2026-20293
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 7.1
- **Description:** An authenticated user with a valid UCS role, or an unauthenticated attacker with physical access, can use UEFI Shell memory-write commands to bypass Secure Boot and run unauthorized software.
- **Relevance:** The advisory explicitly affects Cisco UCS B-, C-, E-, S-, and X-Series systems and certain UCS-based appliances.
- **Source:** [Cisco advisory](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/csa/cisco-sa-ucs-uefi-sb-bypass-eb6xC5GW.html)

### 5. Microsoft Windows exploited zero-days

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-81963 and CVE-2026-85880
- **Severity:** Important, CVSS 3.1 7.8 for each; Microsoft reports both exploited in the wild.
- **Description:** Link-following in Windows Update Stack and an ALPC flaw can let a local attacker elevate to SYSTEM.
- **Relevance:** Windows 10 and Windows Server are monitored; applicability depends on the exact supported/ESU build.
- **Source:** [Microsoft September 2026 analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsofts-september-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-964-cves-cve-2026-81963-cve-2026-85880)

### 6. Microsoft Windows network-service RCEs

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-69525 (Remote Desktop Services), CVE-2026-69730 (Windows DNS Server), and CVE-2026-69676 (Kerberos)
- **Severity:** CVSS 9.8 Important, 9.8 Critical, and 8.8 Critical, respectively.
- **Description:** The DNS flaw is unauthenticated remote code execution; the Remote Desktop issue is a use-after-free assessed as exploitation more likely; the Kerberos issue uses capture-replay after low-level access.
- **Relevance:** These services are common Windows Server roles and directly match the monitored Windows and remote-desktop scope.
- **Source:** [Microsoft September 2026 analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsofts-september-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-964-cves-cve-2026-81963-cve-2026-85880)

### 7. Microsoft Office and SQL Server critical update sets

- **Issues:** Office includes critical RCEs such as CVE-2026-78509 (Outlook, 9.8), CVE-2026-78510 (Word, 9.8), CVE-2026-77504 (Word, 8.8), and multiple additional Word, PowerPoint, and Office CVEs. SQL Server includes CVE-2026-65669 (9.6 privilege escalation) and critical RCEs CVE-2026-67378, CVE-2026-67631, CVE-2026-67636, and CVE-2026-67643.
- **Severity:** Critical for the CVEs named above; the wider September bundle contains 104 Critical and 860 Important CVEs across Microsoft products.
- **Description:** The Office set contains document/client code-execution and information-disclosure flaws; the SQL Server set contains code-execution, privilege-escalation, and security-feature-bypass issues.
- **Relevance:** Microsoft Office and MSSQL/SQL Server are explicitly monitored. The same release also covers monitored .NET, ASP.NET Core, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, OpenSSH for Windows, and Defender Firewall components, so deployment tooling should use Microsoft's full product/version applicability data.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/), [ZDI September review](https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/blog/2026/9/8/the-september-2026-security-update-review)

### 8. Adobe Photoshop critical code-execution vulnerabilities

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-76199, CVE-2026-82007, CVE-2026-82006, CVE-2026-75631, CVE-2026-82005, CVE-2026-75863, CVE-2026-75862, and CVE-2026-75771
- **Severity:** Critical; CVSS 7.8 to 8.6
- **Description:** Search-path, integer-overflow, heap-buffer-overflow, and out-of-bounds-write flaws can lead to arbitrary code execution after user interaction. Adobe reports no known exploitation.
- **Relevance:** Adobe Photoshop is explicitly monitored; affected releases are Photoshop 2026 27.6 and earlier and Photoshop 2025 26.11.6 and earlier.
- **Source:** [Adobe APSB26-130](https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/photoshop/apsb26-130.html)

### 9. Adobe Acrobat and Reader security update

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-81996, CVE-2026-81994, CVE-2026-81983, CVE-2026-79907, CVE-2026-79908, CVE-2026-79909, CVE-2026-80161, CVE-2026-81973, CVE-2026-81975, CVE-2026-81976, CVE-2026-81992, CVE-2026-81979, CVE-2026-81980, CVE-2026-81981, CVE-2026-81985 through CVE-2026-81990, and additional Important/Moderate CVEs in APSB26-141.
- **Severity:** Critical, Important, and Moderate; highest listed CVSS is 8.8.
- **Description:** The bulletin addresses arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, file-system read/write, memory exposure, and application denial of service. Adobe reports no known exploitation.
- **Relevance:** Adobe Acrobat is explicitly monitored; affected versions include Acrobat/Reader Continuous 26.002.21900 and earlier and Acrobat 2024 Classic 24.001.30383 and earlier.
- **Source:** [Adobe APSB26-141](https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb26-141.html)

### 10. ONLYOFFICE ownCloud connector SSRF

- **Issue:** CVE-2026-84282
- **Severity:** Not yet stated in the authoritative CVE record.
- **Description:** An authenticated administrator can supply a Document Server URL that makes the ownCloud host connect to localhost or internal systems, enabling internal reconnaissance and TCP port scanning.
- **Relevance:** This is an official ONLYOFFICE integration and is plausibly relevant to the monitored ONLYOFFICE product family, but only installations using the ownCloud connector version 9.12 are affected.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-84282)

### Closing

Immediate review is recommended. Prioritize MongoDB CVE-2026-82067 and the unauthenticated MongoDB DoS issues, the two exploited Windows elevation-of-privilege zero-days, exposed Windows DNS/RDP/Kerberos services, and the critical Adobe application updates. Confirm product/version applicability before deployment, particularly for Windows Server 2012 R2 and Windows 10 systems that require Extended Security Updates.
